stem.text: Which compound has the molecular formula $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: a cyclopentanone ring (C=O) with a methyl group on another ring carbon.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: a ketone C=O bonded to a CH3 group and to a quaternary carbon carrying three methyl groups.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: a six-membered ring with a C=O group and a C=C double bond in the ring.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: an alkene C=CH2 with a methyl group, a CH bearing a methyl group, and a terminal CH2OH group.
